😍😍😍😍😍😍😍
My last dog was a dobie 
❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

He was actually a mutt mix but he was the best dog ever-so loving and loyal-I can’t wait to move so we can rescue another one!!

Your hair is really super cute!!!

Two months ago I went tickle me Elmo red and it faded over time into this light pink/blonde.

There were people who though I had a wig on as well-but nothing to the extent of trying to rip my hair out!

I wish I had pix because my kids LOVED it

And it was really light and pretty.


Until it started growing out-my natural hair is a dark shit brown color🤦🏻‍♀️


So I went back to blonde and I have to do that several times til this red streak fades out.

Wear a corset and have it tailored to fit your body.
Quite frankly she should have picked a dress that flatters everybody’s figures.


FYI that dress is hideous

I’m “breast blessed” believe me I know a few things. 

What she should have done was dress the bridesmaids all the same and have the jr bridesmaids dress similar but slightly different dresses.

I can also recommend a tanning lotion-make sure to loofah and scrub your skin first-dry thoroughly
Lotion everywhere

Dry thoroughly

And enjoy your fake baked skin!!
Signed
A fellow Casper

Thigh highs and a garter belt

That’s what I did that last time I wore a dress!!
I can’t stand pantyhose-they divide my middle into something weird and odd shaped

Unless you can tan yourself enough to NOT need pantyhose
Lmao well then demand gourmet chocolates!!!

Call CPS 

She’s allowing her children to run around unsupervised/unattended and they’re at risk for being kidnapped and/or severely hurt


Not to mention she’s trespassing and harassing you/your family
I wanna know why he’s flip-flopping and now there’s a family event but you’re not allowed to go....honey-think about this relationship carefully.

Nope Mooching Momma has got to go.
Sit her down with DH and tell her it’s time exit stage left.

Set a timeline-and a budget and stick to it.
She’s gonna need to save x amount for rent whether she get s rental house or rents a room.

And if that’s not doable-there’s senior living!

Hand his ass the cleaning cloth and a bottle of cleaner and he’s not to leave that bathroom until it’s clean


Okay so my stepkids BM went through this with her SS16 and my SS12 a few years back-she told her boyfriend and DH (the father’s) she wanted the dads to give bathroom lessons INCLUDING HOW TO CLEAN THE SPRINKLE WHEN THEY TINKLE.

BM also has issues with the girls so everybody got lessons.

Thankfully my two stepkids and DD15 all know to wipe the seat when they’re done-they’ve been doing it for years.

Omfg
DD15 is severe mentally delayed/retardation and not even she is that bad.

Omg SD17 and I went over everything with her-she wears gloves/uses wipes/has special period baggies for her trash (whatever helps her). Never had this problem.


I would snap if I had to clean somebody’s period blood off my toilet

That was me years ago-my mother never sat us down and explained.

My education was a 30min lecture from the 80+yr old school nurse in 3rd grade!!!

I vowed to never be that parent-hence why I explained everything to SD & DD.

I wish more parents did the same.

Let me say this-call your dr.

This happened to my eldest. She thought she was peeing herself (she’s got bladder/kidney issues) and thought it was a UTI-turns put her water broke and two days later we had a beautiful Granddaughter 

And kick him in his nappy sacks

Tell Dipshit that if you don’t get medical attention so much can go wrong and that baby could die-or even worse you both die.

My ex was the same way-which made no sense because I had excellent health coverage. He paid for nothing. And wasn’t even involved in my pregnancy.


Good grief some men have no business procreating
(No offense to you sweetie some men just lose their brains)

Either start relocating things or perhaps somebody relocate MIL for the day so y’all can safely move.


I wouldn’t put it past her to start hiding/trashing your stuff NOW.

Poor SD-neither Mommy it Daddy wanna deal with her so SM has to.
Eh eh nip that shit.

If Dad wants her-DAD GETS HER.
I’ve walked right out of my house when DH expected me to drop everything for his kids.

Nope not happening.

It’s one thing to say “hey BM has something going on-can you manage the kids for me?!” But it’s DISRESPECTFUL FOR HIM TO SAY “of course I’ll take our daughter and pass her to my gf/wife/spouse to deal with her since you and I choose to.”
It was later changed after Christina left that anybody could win the award.

My daughter and stepkids grew up together-as dh and I have been together for over 12yrs.

So all they know is they’re brother/sister.

If you and your dh have been together only a few years that sibling bond may not be there.

If you and DH have any shared kids,then yes they’re his siblings! 

I don’t believe in half/step bullshit
He was paralyzed if I remember correctly.

I’m going to be blunt-your parents know how she is-they never should have allowed her in the house knowing she’s unstable.

Call the cops-she’s high & drunk and unsafe to be around her kids.

I’m sorry the kiddies had to go through that-it sucks when you deal with asshole parents.

They never really discuss it-but quite honestly I can see why it bugs you.

I would think maybe Amelia or Maggie could have a seat....is Webber on the board?! If not,he should definitely have one as well.

You’re not the only one!

I was loving that glance he gave her walking away

You’re normal😌
You sound like my Aunt M

Who’s an amazing big sister to me-she’s child free
She isn’t one for being too handsy/affectionate with us kids but she does good enough! We rarely see her as she’s long distance-but she sends post cards for my daughter who collects them and sends fun stuff like cutesy socks or a sampler of chocolates 

Trust me when she hits early teens you’ll be able to do good.

Buy niece a nice treat now and again-be supportive and awesome.

There are many like you who are child free by choice and are good people.


My aunt M-is a great person/but she’s never been comfortable around babies and toddlers. She would send cutesy frou frou outfits for DD15 to candy and special treats and as DD grew up their relationship got better.

You can be the fun older sister type when she’s a teen.
When Mom says she can’t get a nose piercing and dye her hair green-you’ll sneak her a fake nose ring and spray on hair color lol 

Or you can buy her a jewelry set for her first dance.

Don’t feel bad if you don’t bond.
I wouldn’t expect that from my aunt.

Just be kind and gentle.
That’s the best advice I can give you.
What you’re doing-is good.

Stay on that path and do not ever second guess yourself.

Enjoy Auntie!
Because soon enough Baby Girl will be a young girl into a little lady into a preteen and then into a teen and then she’s off to start her life!

It goes quickly.

You didn’t sign up for any of it-so don’t do it.

Go on strike. Take care of you and your child/children.

He’s a big boy-he can take care of himself.

He’s part of a family and needs to help out around the house & with the kids.

You and he need couple time together sans kids.

Make your needs clear,perhaps compromise on a few things but he should be doing more!

THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT YOU DO!

He needs to step it up.

I realize even if he was the sole breadwinner-you’re at home doing a much harder job tending to the house & family-and he should help AS NEEDED.

This is something my SD and her bf are learning as first time parents trying to juggle work/school plus a newborn.

Be
Patient


When he’s ready he will come home-I deal with Ferals/strays all the time.

How is it animal abuse?!
When my dog had her last litter we were playing with the pups at 4 weeks of age.

Unless
You mean it’s abuse for the pup to removed from mom.....which case it’s not if they have the mother dog.
Yes In that case it’s abusive and bad for the puppy. I know of some friends who have bred and made their buyers wait til the pups were 10-12weeks.

He’s 20-she’s 18 and they’re struggling but determined to do it on their own.
Thankfully she’s graduated a year early (she gets her certification in June!!!) and come September she’ll be in vocational school full time plus working.

I just wish they would let DH & I help more-but I’ll say this-that baby girl has everything and then some!
